system.description:
You have unearthed a strength unusual even among the undead; where others flag and fail you redouble your efforts, and your blows land hard enough to kill the hardiest mortal.

All of your unarmed or clubbing attacks may inflict lethal damage instead of bashing, if you wish. In addition, once per game session you may recoup your lost strength, restoring all used Physical Traits of Brawny, Ferocious, Stalwart, Tough and Wiry at once — you must restore them all together, and any of those Traits still unused when you invoke Prowess cannot be restored later. Prowess costs nothing, does not count as an action, and may be used at any time.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, p.150
